newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Paul F Luz cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Paul F Luz cut to hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais said analyst Rosana Aldworth cut the rating on Companhia Paulista de Forca e Luz SA to hold from buy.

-- The company "is the first Sao Paulo utility scheduled to be privatized. Despite very strong fundamentals, the fact that CPFL is one of the best distributors in terms of efficiency limits upside once private management takes control," the analyst said in a research note.

-- "The preferred shares, though less liquid, are more attractive, showing a 15.8 percent valuation discount relative to the common shares. Therefore at the same time we are downgrading from buy to hold, we recommend switching to the preferred shares," the analyst said.
